meta.task: Build me a checkout page for an online store

defs.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper Header
defs.genInstructions: Build a horizontal multi-step progress header (Cart → Shipping → Delivery → Payment → Review) spanning the top of the checkout page, showing completed, current, and upcoming steps with checkmarks and a store logo/secure-checkout badge. It orients the shopper and lets them jump back to any completed step.
defs.role: Serves as the navigational spine of the checkout, reflecting completion state of every form section and letting the shopper move between them.

effectors.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
effectors.description: When all required address fields validate successfully (and on blur of the last required field), the address form emits a 'shipping step complete' event with the validated address; the stepper marks the Shipping step as complete with a checkmark and advances the current-step indicator to Delivery.

effectors.name: Checkout: Delivery Method Selector
effectors.description: When the shopper selects a shipping speed, the selector emits 'delivery step complete' with the chosen method id; the stepper marks Delivery complete and advances the active indicator to Payment.

effectors.name: Checkout: Payment Method Panel
effectors.description: When card/wallet details pass client-side validation, the payment panel emits 'payment step complete' with the payment method type and masked identifier; the stepper marks Payment complete and moves the active indicator to Review.

targets.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
targets.description: Clicking the Shipping step (only when it is complete or current) emits a 'navigate to step: shipping' event that scrolls the address form into view, expands it if collapsed, and focuses its first input field.

targets.name: Checkout: Payment Method Panel
targets.description: Clicking the Payment step emits 'navigate to step: payment', which scrolls the payment panel into view, expands it, and focuses the card number field.

defs.name: Checkout: Cart Line Items Review
defs.genInstructions: Build a scrollable list of cart line items with product thumbnail, title, variant attributes, unit price, quantity stepper, remove button, and line total, plus a gift-wrap/note toggle per item. It lets the shopper verify and adjust exactly what they are buying before paying.
defs.role: Acts as the authoritative source of what is being purchased, feeding item quantities and prices to the totals panel and delivery estimates.

effectors.name: Checkout: Order Totals & Promo Panel
effectors.description: When an applied promo code targets specific line items, the totals panel emits the discount mapping (item id → discounted amount) and each affected line item renders a strikethrough original price with a discount badge.

targets.name: Checkout: Order Totals & Promo Panel
targets.description: On any quantity change, item removal, or gift-wrap toggle, emit the full updated line-item array (id, unit price, qty, gift-wrap fee); the totals panel recomputes subtotal, tax, and grand total and re-renders immediately.

targets.name: Checkout: Delivery Method Selector
targets.description: Emits the updated item set with weights/shipping classes whenever quantities change or items are removed, causing the delivery selector to re-fetch and re-render available shipping speeds, prices, and arrival-date estimates.

defs.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
defs.genInstructions: Build a two-column contact and shipping address form with email, phone, full name, autocompleted street address, apt/suite, city, state/region, postal code, country select, inline validation, and a 'save address' checkbox. It captures where and to whom the order ships.
defs.role: Collects the destination and contact details that drive available delivery options, tax calculation, and billing defaults for the rest of the checkout.

effectors.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper Header
effectors.description: Receives a 'navigate to step: shipping' event when the shopper clicks the Shipping step, scrolling itself into view, expanding if collapsed, and focusing the first input.

targets.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper Header
targets.description: On successful validation of all required fields, emits 'shipping step complete' with the validated address object so the stepper marks Shipping done and advances to Delivery.

targets.name: Checkout: Delivery Method Selector
targets.description: On postal code / country / state change (debounced, once valid), emits the destination address; the delivery selector re-queries carrier rates and re-renders the method list with updated prices and arrival dates, disabling methods unavailable for that region.

targets.name: Checkout: Order Totals & Promo Panel
targets.description: Emits the validated destination (country, state, postal code) so the totals panel recalculates the tax line and updates the grand total.

targets.name: Checkout: Payment Method Panel
targets.description: Emits the current shipping address so that when the payment panel's 'billing same as shipping' checkbox is checked, its billing fields auto-populate and stay synced with any later address edits.

defs.name: Checkout: Delivery Method Selector
defs.genInstructions: Build a set of selectable radio cards for shipping speeds (Standard, Expedited, Overnight, Local Pickup), each showing carrier, price, and estimated arrival date range, plus an optional delivery-instructions note field. It lets the shopper choose how fast and how the order arrives.
defs.role: Converts the shipping destination and cart contents into a chosen delivery option whose cost and ETA flow into the order totals.

effectors.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
effectors.description: Receives the validated destination address on change; re-queries carrier rates and re-renders the option cards with region-specific prices, ETAs, and disabled states for unavailable methods.

effectors.name: Checkout: Cart Line Items Review
effectors.description: Receives the updated line-item set (weights, shipping classes) on quantity change or removal and recomputes each method's price and arrival estimate.

targets.name: Checkout: Order Totals & Promo Panel
targets.description: On selection of a delivery option, emits the method id, its shipping cost, and ETA; the totals panel replaces the shipping line item with that cost, recalculates tax and grand total, and displays the estimated arrival date.

targets.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper Header
targets.description: On selection, emits 'delivery step complete' with the chosen method id so the stepper marks Delivery complete and advances to Payment.

defs.name: Checkout: Payment Method Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a payment section with tabs for card, digital wallets (Apple Pay/PayPal), and gift card, containing a formatted card number field with live brand detection, expiry, CVC, name on card, a 'billing address same as shipping' checkbox with a collapsible billing address form, and encryption notice. It captures how the shopper pays.
defs.role: Collects and validates the payment instrument that authorizes the order, gating the place-order action in the totals panel.

effectors.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
effectors.description: Receives the current shipping address; when 'billing same as shipping' is checked, the collapsed billing fields mirror it and stay synced with subsequent address edits.

effectors.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper Header
effectors.description: Receives a 'navigate to step: payment' event on stepper click, scrolling into view, expanding, and focusing the card number field.

targets.name: Checkout: Progress Stepper Header
targets.description: On successful client-side validation of the selected payment method, emits 'payment step complete' with method type and masked identifier so the stepper marks Payment done.

targets.name: Checkout: Order Totals & Promo Panel
targets.description: Emits payment validity state plus the selected method label and masked last-four; the totals panel enables or disables the Place Order button accordingly and shows the chosen payment method in its review summary.

defs.name: Checkout: Order Totals & Promo Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a sticky right-rail summary card with a promo code input and apply button, itemized subtotal, discount, shipping, tax, and bold grand total, estimated arrival line, chosen payment method summary, a large Place Order button with loading state, and terms/refund policy links. It is where the shopper confirms cost and commits to the purchase.
defs.role: Aggregates cart, delivery, discount, and payment state into the final price and hosts the single action that submits the order.

effectors.name: Checkout: Cart Line Items Review
effectors.description: Receives the updated line-item array (id, unit price, qty, gift-wrap fee) on any quantity change, removal, or toggle and recomputes subtotal, tax, and grand total.

effectors.name: Checkout: Shipping Address Form
effectors.description: Receives the validated destination (country, state, postal code) and recalculates the tax line and grand total.

effectors.name: Checkout: Delivery Method Selector
effectors.description: Receives the selected method id, shipping cost, and ETA; updates the shipping line, grand total, and estimated arrival text.

effectors.name: Checkout: Payment Method Panel
effectors.description: Receives payment validity plus method label and masked last-four; enables or disables the Place Order button and renders the payment method summary line.

targets.name: Checkout: Cart Line Items Review
targets.description: After a promo code is applied successfully, emits the per-item discount mapping so affected line items render strikethrough pricing and a discount badge.
